panels.description: Three independent VO2max estimates. Garmin on-device tends to be optimistic. Pipeline CS-model is performance-derived. Per-activity is most variable. β-blocker corrected = ×1.09 for atenolol 25mg selective β1-blocker effect.

panels.description: Garmin's proprietary VO2max from VO2_Max table. Uses HR + pace model. Deduplicated across devices — shows latest value. Typically optimistic vs performance-derived methods.

targets.query: SELECT mean("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter AND "VO2_max_value" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Garmin on-device (medicated)

panels.description: Garmin VO2max × 1.09 to correct for atenolol 25mg β1-blocker suppression. Represents estimated true aerobic ceiling without medication.

targets.query: SELECT mean("VO2_max_value") * 1.09 FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter AND "VO2_max_value" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Garmin on-device (unmedicated est)

panels.description: VO2max_est_run from PerformanceDaily. Derived from critical speed model using best recent running performances. More conservative than Garmin on-device. Uses pipeline HRmax=183.

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2max_est_run") FROM "PerformanceDaily" WHERE $timeFilter AND "VO2max_est_run" > 0

panels.title: CS pipeline — rolling best (medicated)

panels.description: PerformanceDaily VO2max_est_run × 1.09 atenolol correction. Best single number for comparing aerobic fitness to unmedicated athletes or pre-medication baselines.

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2max_est_run") * 1.09 FROM "PerformanceDaily" WHERE $timeFilter AND "VO2max_est_run" > 0

panels.title: CS pipeline — rolling best (unmedicated est)

panels.description: Max vo2max_est from DerivedActivity over last 42 days. Per-activity estimates are more variable — reflects best single-session performance, not a rolling model. Best5m VO2 method.

targets.query: SELECT max("vo2max_est") FROM "DerivedActivity" WHERE time >= now()-42d AND "vo2max_est" > 0

panels.title: Per-activity best 42d (medicated)

panels.description: Max DerivedActivity vo2max_est over 42 days × 1.09 atenolol correction.

targets.query: SELECT max("vo2max_est") * 1.09 FROM "DerivedActivity" WHERE time >= now()-42d AND "vo2max_est" > 0
